snippet.title: Heartworm | Accolades + Bundle Trailer
snippet.description:
How far will you go to recapture the past?

We’re thrilled to announce the fact that Heartworm will be included alongside Crow Country and Hollowbody in the Indie Survival Horror bundle! There has never been a better time to delve back into the dark world of Heartworm, the introspective and cerebral psychological horror game from the mind of Vincent Adinolfi. 

Store page: https://dreadxp.games/Heartworm

Get the bundle: https://dreadxp.games/ISHbundle

Follow the dev: https://x.com/adinolfi

Join the community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
